description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class ResetPasswordServiceTest for testing the ResetPasswordService functionalities in the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It includes setup procedures, test methods for various service behaviors like email generation, password reset, URL validation, and interactions with entities and external dependencies.

classes.name: ResetPasswordServiceTest
classes.description: This class defines unit tests for the ResetPasswordService, covering methods like email service retrieval, password reset request validation, email content generation, user search, email sending, password code generation, saving password resets, logging requests, URL validation, and user validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of ResetPasswordService, setting up fixture data, and configuring mock services.

methods.name: testGetEmailService
methods.description: Tests that the ResetPasswordService successfully provides an EmailService instance.

methods.name: testResetPasswordDao
methods.description: Tests that the ResetPasswordService successfully provides a ResetPasswordDao instance.

methods.name: testHasPasswordResetRequestNotExpired
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly determines whether a password reset request has not expired.

methods.name: testExtractPasswordResetMetaData
methods.description: Tests the extraction of metadata from password reset codes.

methods.name: testGenerateEmailBody
methods.description: Checks that the email body is generated correctly given placeholders and replacements.

methods.name: testSearchForUserRecord
methods.description: Validates the search functionality for user records by username.

methods.name: testSendPasswordResetCodeEmail
methods.description: Tests sending of password reset emails and mocks URL generation.

methods.name: testGeneratePasswordResetCode
methods.description: Verifies that the generated password reset code contains the expected username.

methods.name: testSaveResetPassword
methods.description: Tests saving reset password credentials and checks for success/failure cases.

methods.name: testLogPasswordResetRequest
methods.description: Verifies logging of password reset requests, including mock behaviors.

methods.name: testValidateUrl
methods.description: Checks valid and invalid reset password URLs for proper validation.

methods.name: testVerifyUser
methods.description: Validates user entity correctness and handling in the reset process.
